page_title: FRO 2-1 GEN | Frosinone v Genoa 26/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+4' 2 - 1 Ilario Monterisi (Frosinone) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes a low shot into the bottom right corner. What a clinical finish!
90+1' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Frosinone, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
90+1' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90+1' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) sees a yellow card from Luca Zufferli after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
89' Pablo Galdames (Genoa) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the middle of the goal, but Stefano Turati is prepared to thwart his effort.
88' It's time for a substitution. Silvan Hefti (Genoa) comes on in place of Milan Badelj.
88' Alberto Gilardino has decided to substitute Ridgeciano Haps and he is replaced by Pablo Galdames (Genoa).
88' Substitution. Johan Vasquez (Genoa) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Alessandro Vogliacco walks off.
86' It’s the correct decision – NO PENALTY for Genoa! VAR comes to the rescue of referee Luca Zufferli and both teams have no complaints.

86' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Genoa.
86' Surely that's handball by one of the Frosinone players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
84' The corner is swung in but Frosinone can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
80' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Walid Cheddira walks off the pitch to be replaced by Kaio Jorge (Frosinone).
80' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to make a change. Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) replaces Reinier.
80' We are about to witness a substitution. Junior Messias (Genoa) is replacing Ruslan Malinovsky.

78' Matias Soule (Frosinone) attempted to send a defence-splitting pass into space where Reinier was lurking. It could have put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players somehow manages to avert the threat.
77' A crossfield pass from Ridgeciano Haps (Genoa) fails to find any of his teammates.
75' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) sends a cross into the box, but Stefano Turati comes off his line to gather the ball.
72' Frosinone take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

72' A lofted cross from Matias Soule (Frosinone) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball goes out of play and Frosinone have been awarded a corner kick.
70' Frosinone can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
69' Eusebio Di Francesco is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Riccardo Marchizza suffers an injury and Ilario Monterisi (Frosinone) comes on.
68' Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa) takes a mid-range free kick and his beautiful strike only rattles the right post.
66' Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
66' Today's referee Luca Zufferli rightly decides to book Reinier (Frosinone) for his harsh tackle.
61' Here is a change. Arijon Ibrahimovic is going off and Eusebio Di Francesco gives the last tactical orders to Giuseppe Caso (Frosinone).
61' Substitution. Mehdi Bourabia leaves the pitch and is replaced by Marco Brescianini (Frosinone).
61' Frosinone quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
61' Reinier (Frosinone) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
59' A player from Genoa commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
59' It seemed like Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
58' Luca Zufferli shows a yellow card to Anthony Oyono (Frosinone) for a tough tackle.
57' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) hits a dipping shot from the edge of the box that's well off target and flies miles wide of the left post.
55' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from George Puscas (Genoa).
52' Half-chance! Riccardo Marchizza (Frosinone) plays a pass into the box, but Josep Martinez reacts well to snuff out the attack.
50' Ridgeciano Haps (Genoa) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
49' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Morten Thorsby (Genoa).
47' A tremendous drive by Arijon Ibrahimovic (Frosinone) from inside the box towards the middle of the goal looks like it's in, but Josep Martinez makes a brilliant save.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' George Puscas (Genoa) fires the ball on goal, but his attempt goes well wide of the left post.
45' Problems for Alberto Gilardino as Kevin Strootman is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Morten Thorsby (Genoa) replaces him.
40' The game is interrupted now, Kevin Strootman (Genoa) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

38' 1 - 1 What a beautiful moment! Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the top right corner. Stefano Turati just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 1:1.
34' 1 - 0 Matias Soule (Frosinone) has a sight of goal and unleashes a strike from the edge of the penalty area that somehow goes past the helpless goalkeeper.
34' A player from Frosinone brings down an opponent and commits a foul.
30' Matias Soule (Frosinone) tries to take the opposition by surprise with a quick free kick into the box.
29' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Luca Zufferli ignores the protests.
25' Radu Dragusin (Genoa) didn't manage to convert the resulting corner kick into a goal. He produced a header from a dangerous position inside the box, but it goes well wide of the left post.
25' The ball is out of play. Genoa win a corner kick.
22' Referee Luca Zufferli has finally had enough of Alberto Gilardino and brandishes a yellow card at him!
16' Frosinone are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
12' Reinier (Frosinone) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
11' Riccardo Marchizza (Frosinone) had an opportunity from long range. His low shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Josep Martinez was alert and made a comfortable save.
9' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) pounces on a great cross inside the box, but lashes his powerful first-time shot a whisker past the right post.
6' The foul by Alessandro Vogliacco (Genoa) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Luca Zufferli.
4' Genoa will take a corner kick.
1' What a wasted opportunity by Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa)! He unleashed a powerful low shot from the centre of the box, but Stefano Turati makes a decent save to thwart him.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Genoa will take the kick-off.
Luca Zufferli was nominated as the referee for this game.
